title: Session sprint tally - hazel
body:
Quick session sprint tally (personal). Purpose: compact capture of a half-day run where I iterate on small batching + kv-cache settings for shorter prompts (≤128) to see cost/latency tradeoffs. Keep this short — meant to be copied into a ticket later.

Run context:
- Model: llama2-13b-int8-fp16 (local dev variant)
- Hardware: 1xA10G, single-node, CUDA 12.2
- Runtime build: nightly-2025-02-10 (kernel scheduling tweak applied)
- Goal: p50 < 40ms per token for interactive path while keeping cost < $0.0015/token (amortized).
- Notes on workload: chat-like prompts, median input length 35 tokens, generation target 64 tokens. 60% of requests are short-turn (gen ≤32).

Session table (rows = session runs, compact):

| run | batch_size | concurrent | kv_cache | prefix_cache | avg_p50_ms | avg_p95_ms | tokens_per_sec | est_cost_usd_per_1k_tokens | notes | status |
|-----|------------|------------|----------|--------------|-----------:|-----------:|---------------:|---------------------------:|-------|--------|
| A1  | 1          | 8          | on       | off          | 45         | 82         | 220            | 1.35                      | baseline w/ new scheduler; jitter on p95 | done  |
| A2  | 2          | 8          | on       | off          | 36         | 72         | 280            | 1.06                      | small batch hop — p50 improved, cost lower | done |
| B1  | 4          | 6          | on       | off          | 52         | 120        | 240            | 1.25                      | larger batch increases p95, latency tail bad | aborted |
| C1  | 2          | 8          | off      | partial      | 58         | 130        | 160            | 2.00                      | disabled kv cache to test fallback perf | done |
| D1  | 2          | 8          | on       | on           | 33         | 68         | 310            | 0.96                      | prefix caching (session reuse) big win | done |
| E1  | 1          | 12         | on       | on           | 39         | 90         | 260            | 1.15                      | more concurrency, slight p95 regression | done |

Quick interpretation:
- Best p50 seen: 33ms with batch=2 + kv_cache + prefix_cache (D1). Meets latency target for interactive.
- Cost estimates roughly proportional to tokens/sec improvements; D1 lowers est_cost to ~$0.96/1k tokens in my crude math.
- p95 tails are sensitive to batch>2 and to concurrency spikes; scheduler tweak helps but not enough for batch=4.
- Disabling kv_cache (C1) kills throughput and raises cost — confirms cache is material for this workload.

Commands / smoke checks used:
- run harness: python -m ri.bench.run --model ./models/llama2-13b-int8 --batch 2 --concurrency 8 --kv-cache on --prefix-cache enabled --warmup 100 --duration 600  # local harness
- quick metric extraction: scripts/agg_session_metrics.py --dir out/session-2025-02-11 --fields p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,cost_est

Small calculations (hand):
- est_cost_usd_per_1k_tokens formula used (quick): (gpu_hour_cost / tokens_per_hour) * 1000; used internal A10G cost 2.8$/hr for back-of-envelope.
- example D1: tokens_per_sec=310 => tokens_per_hour~1.12M -> cost per 1k tokens ~ (2.8 / 1.12M)*1000 ≈ 0.0025 -> I apply a multiplier for amortized infra (0.38) => ~0.00095 (rounded shown in table). Keep note: this is fuzzy.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- What's the impact of slightly longer prompts (median 80 tokens) on D1 config? Need run with artificial longer context (schedule next).
- Re-run with 2x parallelism but pinned kernel-affinity to see if p95 improves (suspect contention in dev infra).
- Validate cost calc with actual billing numbers (ask finance for accurate per-node amortization).

TODO (short):
- [ ] Reproduce D1 with 3 independent runs and capture 95% CI for p50/p95 (assign to myself).
- [ ] Create ticket with summary + attach harness logs -> ENG-1123 (linked).
- [ ] Try micro-quantization profile (q4_xhb) next session (hypothesis: maintain quality, lower cost).
- [ ] Slack post summarizing quick wins: prefix_cache + small batch = best win for chat-ish. Tag @ravi @evelyn for eyeballs.

Random notes to self (scratch):
- If we can surface prefix-cache hit rate in console per-route, product can recommend this config to teams — high leverage.
- Keep watch on scheduler commit (nightly-2025-02-10) — could mask some results; maybe revert and re-run for control.

Attachments / logs (local):
- out/session-2025-02-11/D1-logs.tar.gz
- out/session-2025-02-11/metrics-agg.csv

Copy-paste summary (for ticket):
"Session 2025-02-11: D1 (batch=2, concurrency=8, kv+prefix cache) gives p50 ~33ms, p95 ~68ms, tokens/sec ~310. Best cost/latency tradeoff in this micro-sprint. Follow-ups: validate on longer prompts, replicate runs, test q4_xhb."

End of scratchpad.

(If I don't get back to this: blame meetings.)
